name: Taki Yuutarou no Nariwai
source:
He is pleasent hot-blooded, mildly vivacious, easy-going, and sincere.

He is loved by people of all ages, men and women, low and high, rich and poor, and the whole gamut of things.

Great Teacher Yutaro Taki (28).

This is the story of his slightly or extremely dangerous "side job".

[From [url=https://8yml.gumroad.com/l/takiyutaros_livelihood]Gumroad[/url]]
